text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hourly values. Orange: AGV, the energy the 14 GSP groups take from the transmission system, times 2 to give megawatts. Blue: the national demand outturn (INDO). In the scatter, the dashed line is equality. The correlation of the 18480 half-hours is 0.996.'
text.tspan: Half-hourly values. Orange: AGV, the energy the 14 GSP groups take from the transmission system, times 2 to give
megawatts. Blue: the national demand outturn (INDO). In the scatter, the dashed line is equality.
The correlation of the 18480 half-hours is 0.996.
